crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.
The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.
Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and…
Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
Give us today our daily bread.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.

translations.web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
translations.bsb: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
translations.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
translations.asv: Better is a little that the righteous hath Than the abundance of many wicked.
